retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s studio portrait layout featuring a large-scale headshot offset by bold, vertically stacked serif and sans-serif typography on a clean, muted background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, three-quarter studio portrait of a smiling male subject positioned on the left, balanced by right-aligned, multi-colored typographic blocks on a cream-to-olive gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the viewer to establish personal connection.
Typographic weight balances the visual mass of the subject's head.
Color-coded text hierarchy distinguishes artist name from album title.
Horizontal header bar provides a structural anchor for technical metadata.
coreInvariants: Tight studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the blue artist name, then down through the red title to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored space on the right to accommodate dense typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive green (header) and Cream (background) for a stable, vintage foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown/black of the suit and hair provides tonal depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty blue and muted brick red for typographic distinction.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all hues to mimic aged offset printing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and high-contrast transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Artist name uses ultra-condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif with tight tracking.
Album title uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals and moderate x-height.
Tracklist uses a small, clean, wide-set serif for legibility.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed sans-serif for impact paired with a classic serif for elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy sans-serif display style.
Captures the high-contrast, traditional serif feel of the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 1960s suit and pompadour hairstyle, smiling, positioned on the left. The background should be a soft cream gradient with a solid olive green bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply right-aligned text blocks on the right side. Use a blue condensed sans-serif for the top name and a red serif for the stacked title below it. Add a small tracklist in black serif at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Are the colors muted and vintage-appropriate?
Is the subject's face clear of any typographic overlap?
Does the olive green header bar span the full width?

postGenerationChecks: Check for '360 Sound' style technical arrows in the header.
Ensure the blue and red text colors do not vibrate against the cream background.
Verify the subject's hair has visible texture and sheen.
Confirm the tracklist is legible but subordinate in scale.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait (Left) + Stacked Color-Coded Typography (Right) + Metadata Header (Top) = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
